gen-luckiest-guy-gf-play: Play keeps its stroke weight shifting gently, never snapping. Over a full page, that soft shift makes the text feel smooth and unfussy, while Luckiest Guy shouts above it in poured, single-width ink.
gen-luckiest-guy-outfit: Cheerful and loud, Luckiest Guy stands tall with its high mean line. Outfit sits lower beneath it, bent like cable into round shapes, so the two feel like a shouted joke and a relaxed reply.
gen-megrim-fs-ranade: Megrim draws thin, angular strokes that all end at the same measured thickness. Ranade then loosens things up, its weight stretching slightly like rubber cord and its widely spaced letters giving a long passage an organic, unhurried pace.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-lepcha: Noto Sans Lepcha reads low and sturdy, with curves that stay wide open. Over a long passage it feels approachable and steady, a grounded counterpart to the sharp, futuristic lines of Megrim.
gen-megrim-montserrat: Montserrat glides along with generous white space leading into each curve. Megrim's angular heading sits above it, and if space allows, giving the body a little extra size lets those large e and a counters breathe.
gen-metal-mania-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Dense, heavy, and a bit menacing. Be Vietnam Pro answers with sans-serif strokes like bent steel rod, curve endings kept well apart, so Metal Mania's crowded intensity has somewhere to rest.
gen-metal-mania-fs-karma: Karma reads like a trustworthy old book, its terminals finishing well clear of the stem and its thick-thin shifts mellow. Metal Mania's constant-width, intense lettering crashes in over it, so the page feels like a gentle storyteller interrupted by a roar.
gen-metal-mania-rubik: Metal Mania's big, open eye on every e gives it away. Rubik is the soft sans-serif underneath, with lowercase letters that look large beside its capitals, and that mix of heavy and friendly is the pair's best quality.
gen-modak-fs-erode: Fun and approachable, Modak puffs up its letters with strokes that never swell or thin. Erode brings the dignity, its ebb and flow of weight and broad openings on g and a making the pair's mix of play and polish its best quality.
gen-modak-fs-public-sans: Public Sans reads hefty and trustworthy, with broad open counters. Modak's big, washer-eyed lowercase bounces above it, so the page feels like a cheerful greeting followed by a straight answer.
